newsitem.title: INDIA: Yield on Indian 364-day t-bill steady at 10.35 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yield on Indian 364-day t-bill steady at 10.35 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Wednesday it set a cut-off of 90.64 rupees at its fortnightly auction of 364-day treasury bills, unchanged from the previous auction.
Dealers said the yield remained steady at 10.35 percent.
The RBI said it received 26 bids for 3.91 billion rupees of which it accepted 10 for 1.96 billion.
The weighted-average cut-off price worked out to 90.65 rupees, it said.
